messages.content: User task: Help me draft a short apology email to a colleague.

raw_response:
Subject: Apology for My Oversight  

Hi [Colleague’s Name],

I’m sorry for [briefly describe what happened]. It was thoughtless of me and I regret any inconvenience or frustration it caused. I value working with you and will take steps to ensure this doesn’t happen again. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to make things right.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best,  
[Your Name]

PLAN: Identify the colleague’s name  
PLAN: Clarify the specific issue to apologize for  
PLAN: Draft a concise subject line  
PLAN: Write the opening greeting and apology statement  
PLAN: Add a sentence expressing regret and commitment to improve  
PLAN: Close with an offer to make amends and a polite sign‑off  
PLAN: Review the email for tone and brevity before sending
